name: Adult Decision Observatory Personal Release Candidate 1.0 (4)
approvedDesignReference: Hindsight — Adult Decision Observatory Product Contract
userOutcome: A person can privately record a forecast with intentionally selected 0–100 confidence, optional Why, and a future review date; later resolve it and learn from sample-safe, deterministic calibration evidence without any social or remote data path.
entryPoints: Settings privacy, example-data, export, recovery, and deletion controls
productionDataSource: Local SwiftData is authoritative for personal drafts, forecasts, resolutions, reflections, explicit sample provenance, and local derived views. This contract authorizes no account, server, sync, telemetry, or social data source.
errorBehavior: Validation errors remain adjacent to the affected field and move accessibility focus to the first error. A seal or resolution write is one local transaction. On a persistence failure, the view stays open, all entered fields remain in a durable draft, success animation/haptic and reminder side effects do not run, and the person can retry without creating a duplicate. Detailed confidence is explicit and an optional rating remains distinguishable from absent input. Loading failures show a truthful retry state. Sample removal reports the exact targeted count and breakdown; failure preserves real and sample data and offers safe retry. Fast resolution remains coherent, notes are durable, reminder eligibility excludes samples, and deletion/new-decision retries are transaction-safe. No screen claims that a local or social operation succeeded before its authoritative write succeeds.
layoutScenarios: Long prediction, reasoning, and reflection text
Empty, loading, error, retry, and mixed real/sample states
accessibilityRequirements: Confidence is available as a textual 0–100 percentage and never communicated only by a slider position, color, stamp, motion, or haptic.
All primary controls and date choices provide at least 44 by 44 point hit targets with logical VoiceOver focus order.
Prediction, return date, seal state, due state, outcome, sample status, error, retry, and low-sample insight status are exposed in text and announced to assistive technology.
Dynamic Type wraps and vertically expands critical content; statement, confidence, date, audience/status, outcome, and error text are not truncated to preserve layout.
Reduced Motion provides an informationally equivalent static seal, opening, and resolution state; haptics are supplemental only.
Charts provide labels, date range, eligible-record denominator, low-sample state, and an accessible summary/explainer route.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not create a forecast without non-empty statement text, intentional 0–100 confidence, and a valid future review date.
Do not show a locked success state, success haptic, dismissal, reminder, or notification side effect before the local transaction commits.
Do not permit a duplicate tap, retry, stale task, or relaunch recovery to create more than one forecast or resolution for the same intended action.
Do not silently discard a capture or resolution draft after validation, persistence, interruption, or recoverable failure.
Do not rewrite locked statement text, confidence, original Why, or review date when resolving or reflecting.
Do not include sample records in real analytics, counts, streaks, exports, reminders, notifications, or relationships.
Do not identify samples by title, body text, appearance, or heuristic; use explicit stable sample provenance only.
Do not delete real data while loading or removing samples, including a real record whose text matches a sample.
Do not auto-load, auto-remove, silently convert, sync, share, or migrate sample or personal records.
Do not show claims from insufficient records, omit denominators, or present cancelled/unresolvable/sample records as calibration evidence.
Do not enable friends, Circles, accounts, backend/sync, messages, public events, leaderboards, or social sharing in this candidate. Social flags default off and fail closed.
Do not send prediction text, Why, reflection, sample content, identifiers, or analytics telemetry to a remote service.
acceptanceTests: testCapture_requiresStatementIntentionalConfidenceAndFutureReviewDate: Lock stays unavailable or shows field-local errors until all required values are valid.
testCapture_confidenceSliderPersistsEveryBoundary: 0, 1, 50, 99, and 100 persist exactly and expose a matching textual accessibility value.
testCapture_detailedConfidenceIsExplicitAndOptionalRatingPresencePersists: detailed confidence requires an intentional selection and an absent optional rating is not serialized as a value.
testCapture_optionalWhyMayBeBlankAndPersistsWhenPresent: blank Why saves; non-empty Why round-trips unchanged.
testCapture_atomicLockCreatesExactlyOneForecast: repeated Lock taps and retry after an indeterminate UI transition commit at most one record.
testCapture_failedSavePreservesDurableDraftAndRunsNoSuccessSideEffects: reopen/relaunch retains statement, confidence, Why, and date; no success UI or reminder occurs before a successful retry.
testForecast_lockedOriginalFieldsAreImmutableDuringResolution: resolution/reflection changes do not alter statement, confidence, Why, creation timestamp, or review date.
testResolution_atomicWriteAndRetryDoesNotDuplicateOutcome: a failure retains outcome/reflection draft and retry produces one resolution.
testToday_dueStatusUsesLocalCalendarAndTimeZoneSafely: future, due, and overdue presentation updates without losing the forecast.
testInsights_dueDateEligibilityUsesLocalCalendarAndTimeZoneSafely: only real due terminal binary forecasts are eligible for calibration.
testHistory_filtersSearchOnlyResolvedRealForecasts: expected filtering and empty state occur without exposing samples as real history.

testInsights_excludesSamplesCancelledAndUnresolvableRecords: eligible real terminal binary forecasts alone affect observed rate, mean confidence, signed calibration gap, Brier score, bands, and counts.
testInsights_lowSampleStateShowsDenominatorAndNoClaim: sparse history produces an honest insufficient-data state with explainer route.
testSampleFixtures_haveStableExplicitProvenanceAndIdempotentLoad: loading twice does not duplicate sample objects.
testSampleRemoval_deletesOnlyExplicitSampleProvenance: a real forecast with identical sample text survives removal.
testSampleRemoval_failureIsRetryableAndPreservesRealData: failed removal makes no partial claim of success and retry is safe.
testReminderSchedulingExcludesSamplesAndFastResolutionKeepsNotesDurable: samples never create reminders; fast resolution is coherent and note retry preserves text.
testDeletionAndNewDecisionRetriesAreTransactionSafe: retries neither delete unintended data nor create a duplicate decision.
testSocialFlagsDefaultOffAndNoRemotePathIsReachable: accounts, sync, Circles, groups, messages, and public features fail closed.
UI smoke: Today -> Capture -> Lock -> Today -> Resolve -> History succeeds on smallest supported iPhone and iPhone 16 Pro Max.
UI smoke: example-data load -> explicit sample markers -> remove examples leaves a real forecast and routes cleanly to real/empty state.
Accessibility/UI audit: largest Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, dark mode, increased contrast, keyboard visible, and Reduce Motion preserve all required information and actions.
Persistence/relaunch test: a locked forecast and an interrupted durable capture draft survive app termination and relaunch.
